This is not in the refuted-99 categories. It is not VACUOUS, not adjacent-claim, the declarations exist, and the file builds. The mathematical content is real: a false pricing was removed from the headline leaf and replaced by a measured one. But the "same one statement, and no more" framing is an overreach, and commit `d4dc053cd` silently reverted another lane.

## Claim (1) — CONFIRMED

Every engine is genuinely generic. Checked binders directly:

- `/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge/AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0DualNumberCocycle.lean:430` — `pointedDualNumberPointsEquivAddKernel` takes `(G, rep)` explicitly, no Picard anything.

- `.../TangentSpaceIdentitySection.lean:123` — arbitrary `X` and section.
- `.../Pic0TangentSpace.lean:93` — arbitrary `X` with `[LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]`.

No step needs `picSharp` or `[HasPicScheme C]`. `picSharp` really did enter only at the application sites.

## Claim (2) — CONFIRMED on all three sub-points; "axiom-clean" is MISLEADING as stated

(a) It is about the étale sheaf. `PicScheme.picEt C = (PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat` holds by `rfl` (probe compiled), so `representableEt C` is exactly the datum the engine wants. (b) No rational-point or `HasPicScheme` binder. (c) The proof projects nothing it assumed.

```
-- depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
```

| clause | picSharp residue | your `SemilinearCotangentComparisonEt` |
|---|---|---|
| `∀ S : AffineCoverMVSquare` | yes | yes |
| `∃ i : κ(e) → k` | yes | yes |
| `∃ j : Dual(cotangent) ≃+ S.H1Cok` | yes | yes |
| `Function.Bijective i` | yes | yes |
| `∀ r x, j (r • x) = i r • j x` | yes | yes |

It is a genuine two-sided constraint. Your `subsingleton_h1Cok_of_genus_eq_zero` self-audit is accurate — genus 0 discharges one carrier only.

## Claim (4) — OVERREACH. This is the finding that matters

The two statements are the same *shape* but about different left carriers, and yours absorbs an extra step you did not name.

Your kernel description lands in a kernel of `(PicSharp.etaleSheaf C).obj` — the **sheafification** (`PicEtSheaf.lean:163-167`, `presheafToSheaf.obj (PicSharp.relPresheaf C)`). > So the étale formulation owes the **same one statement** the pointed formulation owes, and no more — which is the point of the file.

And at :242-243, understating it again: "Nothing here reduces that; what is established is that the étale side needs it once rather than twice." The count is right; the identification of the two statements is not. Not extra sorries and not a weakening — unnamed cost inside a named hypothesis. Filed as I-0989, with the durable lesson as I-0990.

Both docstring repairs are correct. `Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne` does report `sorryAx` (measured above), so deleting "landed mathematics" was right. And the deleted claim that transport "needs the comparison of the two Picard schemes, which is available only under a section" was false, as claim (1) establishes. `Jacobian.lean` sorry count unchanged.

name: generic-engines-vs-residue-carrier
description: Every step of a chain being generic proves the chain restates at a new object; it says nothing about whether the final hypothesis is the same statement
metadata:

---

When a docstring prices "transporting this development to object B needs machinery X",
the refutation is to check whether every *step* is quantified over the data B supplies.
That check is cheap and often wins: in AJC the whole dual-number tangent-space leg took
`(functor, RepresentableBy)` as arguments, so the chain restated at `Pic0SchemeEt` with
`representableEt` and needed no comparison of the two Picard schemes — the docstring had
put a headline leaf behind a specification change it did not need.

But "all the steps are generic" is an argument about the steps. It does not transfer to
the chain's **residue**. The picSharp residue compared against a kernel of `relPresheaf`
(invertible-sheaf classes); mine compared against a kernel of the *sheafification*. Same
clause-for-clause shape, no weakening, not vacuous — and strictly harder, because
bridging the two carriers is a lemma the project does not have and that holds only under
the hypothesis the reformulation exists to avoid. I published "owes the SAME one
statement, and no more" and a fresh-context audit refuted it.

**Why:** the genericity check licenses each arrow, and the residue is not an arrow — it
is a hypothesis *about two objects*, one of which changed when you moved to B.

**How to apply:** after establishing the steps restate, diff the residue's two carriers
by name and grep for a lemma relating them. If none exists, say "one hypothesis rather
than two, and it is harder" — never "the same statement". Related:
[[price-the-consumer-carrier]], [[prescriptions-need-auditing-like-measurements]],
[[goals-measure-difficulty-not-ingredients]].
